## New strategy

Related strategy proposal:

- [ ] Adds data only in community paths from CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Redistribution permission and attribution/license are stated for all files.
- [ ] Account identifiers, balances, chat, personal paths and private imports are removed.
- [ ] Geometry, camera, loadout, modifiers, UI version and actual trials are documented.
- [ ] Simulated checks and live-game outcomes are distinguished.

Core-code changes are owner-maintained; open a suggestion issue for implementation changes.
